activities.title: The Water Feature Laser Show
activities.description: Watch the 4,000-gallon indoor water fountain perform a choreographed show with lasers, lights, and music. It runs continuously and projects NYC themes into the falling water.

activities.title: Tarmac Views from the Skybridge
activities.description: Walk across the elevated pedestrian skybridges connecting the concourses. Because they are built directly over active taxiways, you get an incredible top-down view of aircraft passing right beneath your feet.

activities.title: Junior's Cheesecake & Deli
activities.description: Skip the generic fast food and grab a slice of authentic Brooklyn cheesecake or a towering pastrami sandwich from this iconic NYC staple without leaving the airport.

activities.title: The Bowery Bay Shops
activities.description: Browse a 17,000-square-foot retail space modeled after a classic Manhattan shopping street, featuring local NYC brands like Strand Bookstore.
